messages:
nina: quick flag — onboarded Aurelia-embed-v3 (fp16->int4-perchannel) through the usual holdout. medium-length query cohort (9-25 tokens) shows a weird pattern: recall@10 improves, recall@1 drops for many topical queries.
tom: can you paste the cohort table? numbers?
jess: also any change in silhouette / cluster purity?
nina: summary below (cohort = 'medium-topical'):
```
model    recall@1  recall@5  recall@10  purity  silhouette
aurelia-v2(fp16) 0.55 0.77 0.85 0.68 0.39
aurelia-v3(int4) 0.42 0.79 0.88 0.62 0.31
delta  -0.13 +0.02 +0.03 -0.06 -0.08
```
leo: interesting: recall@10 up but recall@1 down suggests more diffuse nearests but better coverage at k=10. Could be smoothing of distances.
jess: did you change whitening / PCA dims?
nina: no, pipeline identical. used release-2026-02 whitening. quant profile int4-perchannel-q2. Also noticed median vector norm decreased ~15%.
tom: decreased norms + int4 might push many vectors toward the origin. that can reorder nearest neighbors under cosine. try L2-normalize off or adjust scale.
ops-bot: queued task: infra-provision-cc-small -> approved.
nina: re-ran quick check with L2-normalize off (dot prod): recall@1 = 0.44, recall@10 = 0.87. small bump at r@1 but still -0.11 vs baseline.
jess: per-dim kurtosis/zero-rate?
nina: per-dim zero-rate up ~6% in v3 for rare dims; kurtosis increased in tail dims. suggests quant pushes small activations to zero.
leo: @eval-bot can you run two variants: (A) int4-perchannel with scale-bias recovery, (B) int6-perchannel for the cohort sweep. also run a synthetic perturbation test replacing topical tokens with synonyms to test robustness.
eval-bot: queued aurelia-retest-1770012345-A (int4+scale-bias-recover). queued aurelia-retest-1770012345-B (int6-perchannel). queued aurelia-syn-pert-1770012345 (synonym perturb probe). ETA ~22m. :gear:
jess: also try compiling with kernel-set 'legacy-k3' (v2 used legacy-k3) — v3 defaulted to fast-k11. kernel artifacts + int4 sometimes produce tiny rounding differences that reorder neighbors.
tom: good catch. nina, can you compile v3 with legacy-k3 and run the base sweep?
nina: compiling with legacy-k3 now, will run same harness. eval command used:
```
./eval_harness --dataset aurelia-holdouts-v1 --cohort medium-topical
  --model aurelia-v3-int4-q2 --metric recall@k --k 10 --normalize cosine --batch 128
```
leo: mitigation idea: route medium-topical -> v2(fp16) for traffic where top1 precision is critical (e.g., search). fallback rule based on heuristic: has_query_type=="search" AND token_count between 9 and 25.
jess: create ticket and runbook?
nina: opened ticket ML-1842: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ML-1842. Attached eval table, command, and S3 vectors s3://redwood-evals/aurelia/1770012345/. assigning to @tom and @leo.
eval-bot: aurelia-retest-1770012345-A finished -> recall@1=0.47, recall@10=0.88 (delta vs v2 r@1 = -0.08). aurelia-retest-1770012345-B finished -> recall@1=0.52, recall@10=0.86 (delta r@1 = -0.03).
tom: B looks closest to parity for r@1 but cost will increase. A improves recall@10 more. suggests int6 trades cost for top1 precision.
nina: compiled v3 with legacy-k3 + int4+A (scale-bias-recover) -> recall@1 = 0.50, recall@10 = 0.89, silhouette 0.36.
eops-bot: permission required to push routing rule to staging.
leo: I'll add the staging route for the heuristic and run canary at 5% traffic to measure live delta. if r@1 delta <= 0.05 we keep v3; else fallback to v2.
jess: also add a drift metric: median vector norm and per-cohort r@1 rolling window alert when delta>0.06 for 15m.
nina: all follow-ups in ML-1842. plan: (1) run canary staging with kernel+bias fix (2) monitor live r@1 and vector norms (3) if still bad, route to v2 for search traffic and revisit quant profile. target decision: TOMorrow AM.
tom: thanks everyone. one more ask: export nearest-neighbor examples for ~100 failures (queries where v3 top1 != v2 top1) into the ticket for manual review.
nina: on it, uploading now.
